screen.stashradar.title: Stash Radar: where did I put it?
screen.stashradar.hint: Type an item name, e.g. diamond
screen.stashradar.empty: Type an item name, or a # and a tag. Enter picks the first one.
screen.stashradar.none: No item with that name. Use the button above to search names.
screen.stashradar.range.tip: How far to search, in blocks. Click to change. The server may allow less.
screen.stashradar.text.tip: Finds every item whose name contains this text, including renamed items and boxes.
screen.stashradar.settings.tip: Range, highlight and what gets searched (single-player and LAN worlds).
screen.stashradar.footer: Click an item or press Enter to search. Esc closes.
screen.stashradar.unavailable: This server doesn't have Stash Radar (or doesn't let you use /find).
screen.stashradar.config.title: Stash Radar settings
screen.stashradar.config.where: Used by your single-player and LAN worlds. A server uses its own config/stashradar.json.
screen.stashradar.config.hover: Point at a setting to see what it does.
screen.stashradar.config.bad: %s must be a whole number from %s to %s.
config.stashradar.range.tip: Blocks searched when no range is given.
config.stashradar.maxRange.tip: Nobody can search farther than this.
config.stashradar.cooldownSeconds.tip: Wait time between searches for one player. Operators skip it.
config.stashradar.highlightSeconds.tip: How long found containers stay outlined.
config.stashradar.maxHighlights.tip: Only the nearest containers get an outline.
config.stashradar.highlightColor.tip: Color of the particle outline, like #3CFF7A.
config.stashradar.searchInsideItems.tip: Also count items inside shulker box items and bundles.
config.stashradar.searchItemFrames.tip: Also find items shown in item frames.
config.stashradar.searchEnderChest.tip: Also say how many are in your own ender chest.
config.stashradar.glowThroughWalls.tip: Far results also glow through walls. Only you see it.
config.stashradar.addCreatorServer.tip: Adds Logic Survival to your server list once.
